convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for TSICloud custom indicator and depends on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trade execution logic. Cannot be auto-converted due to custom indicator dependency.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars needed for indicator warm-up
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: Signal time calculation for position open

other_exits: Oppposite signal triggers close of existing position: buy close on bearish crossover, sell close on bullish crossover

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lot size, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. MM parameter (0.1) serves as either lot size or fraction depending on MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: Invert flag swaps the indicator buffers for signal generation (buffer 0/1 swapped). Entry uses previous bar [1] values for crossover detection with bar [0] as confirmation: BUY_Open requires UpIndSeries[1]>DnIndSeries[1] AND UpIndSeries[0]<=DnIndSeries[0] (cloud crossover from below). SELL_Open requires UpIndSeries[1]<DnIndSeries[1] AND UpIndSeries[0]>=DnIndSeries[0] (cloud crossover from above). SignalBar=1 means signal is read from bar 1 (previous completed bar) by default. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are boolean gates that can disable specific trade directions. Recount flag triggers re-evaluation on next tick if CopyBuffer fails.
python_conversion_notes: TSICloud is a custom indicator with two smoothing passes (configurable method from SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA/JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA) - must reimplement the full TSI calculation in Python including all 10 smoothing methods from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh. The crossover logic uses 2-bar lookback (bar[0] and bar[1]) with directional confirmation. Position sizing is conditional on MarginMode enum - requires implementing all 5 margin calculation modes. The Invert flag simply swaps buffer indices. SignalBar parameter shifts which bar is read for signals. Entry signals persist within a bar (static bools) but reset on new bar.
